__doc__: A.2.3/A.2.4 gates manifest. Giants nav (chotchki, 2026-06-23): pure CROSS (= keyboard X) mashed repeatedly drives the whole opening chain (videos -> menu -> story -> save slot -> Eon's unskippable monologue) to the in-game portal-placement prompt. So the gates collapse to: `default` = press CROSS (mash through everything), and the one real gate = portal_ready -> stop. The unskippable monologue is fast-forwarded by the render storyboard, not skipped in-game. `refs` are PNGs relative to this dir; `crop` is the game-window [x,y,w,h] within the captured display (null = whole frame).
